vjwc4e7h.sourceDescription: Adorned with 350/150/100 pre-lit LED lights, you can choose between warm white or colorful hues. Also, the Xmas tree provides 11 dazzling lighting modes to set the perfect festive mood, including: A slow flash, B steady on, B quick flash, A/B colour changing quick flash, A/B colour changing slow flash, A/B colour changing 5 times, A/B Colour changing slow fade, A/B steady on, and more. Designed for stress-free assembly, the hinged branches spread out effortlessly, supported by a sturdy foldable metal base, while included gloves help you shape each branch safely and neatly. Fast Setup, Easy Handling: Make holiday decorating stress-free with this artificial Christmas tree. The hinged connection helps the branches expand automatically, while the folding metal stand keeps it stable. Plus, the included gloves help protect your hands as you fluff and arrange the branches for a neat, beautiful finish. Premium PVC Material: Crafted from 100% new PVC material, this pre-lit Christmas tree offers comfort and a worry-free holiday feel. It is flame-retardant, non-allergic, anti-fading, and smell-free, so you can enjoy the season without concerns or unpleasant smells. Versatile for Every Holiday Moment: More than a traditional decoration, this full Christmas tree fits multiple scenes and celebrations. Whether you’re styling a living room, setting up a party corner, decorating a dorm, or creating a welcoming storefront vibe, it blends beautifully with your holiday theme. 7rbntfsy.baseName: Walplus 300 LED Fairy Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 180 cm
7rbntfsy.variantName: Walplus 300 LED Fairy Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 180 cm
7rbntfsy.sourceDescription: This Artificial Christmas Tree with LED is a beautifully crafted cone-shaped tree that captures the spirit of the holiday season. Standing 180 cm tall, it features a sleek, modern design characterized by simplicity and functionality, making it a perfect fit for both living rooms and sheltered outdoor areas. Equipped with dynamic LED string lights, this seasonal décor not only brightens up spaces but also adds a touch of festive charm. Its PVC and steel construction ensures durability, supporting annual use across seasons. Material Composition: This artificial tree is crafted using high-quality PVC and steel, ensuring it has a robust structure capable of standing upright in various environments. The PVC material is abrasion-resistant, allowing for many years of festive celebration without wear and tear. Dynamic LED Lights: Equipped with LED string lights that feature dynamic lighting patterns, the tree enhances festive ambiance with changing patterns and colors. The preset options include 8 distinct flash modes, offering a captivating visual display that transforms any space. Simple Assembly: Assembling the tree is straightforward, designed for two people using a screwdriver as per the manufacturer's instructions. This ensures a stable and secure setup, allowing the tree to stand gracefully throughout the holiday season. Space-Efficient Design: With a cone shape and a bottom diameter of 90 cm, this tree is ideal for compact spaces like small living rooms or terraces. It maximizes vertical space usage, providing ample room for festive decoration while maintaining an elegant, understated presence. Versatile Power Source: The tree is powered by a USB plug, offering convenience and flexibility in setup. It eliminates the need for traditional power outlets, making it suitable for areas where such options are limited or unavailable ensuring hassle-free installation. Product Specifications Colour: White Material: PVC and steel Tree height: 180 cm Bottom diameter: 90 cm Durable Number of PVC tips: 564 Lights type: LED string lights Lights color: Purple Number of LEDs: 300 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

wenn6mc5.variantName: Charles Bentley Small Rattan Light Up Reindeer
wenn6mc5.sourceDescription: Add a festive sparkle to your home or garden with our small light up Reindeer – a charming addition to your Christmas display that brings warmth and magic to any setting. Crafted from natural-look rattan woven around a brown metal frame, this elegant deer is wrapped in glowing white Micro LED lights, creating a beautifully soft, seasonal glow. Designed for ease and practicality, the reindeer features a built-in timer (8 hours on, 16 hours off), so you can enjoy coming home to a beautifully lit entrance way with no need to switch on or off all season long. It's suitable for both indoor and outdoor use, and comes supplied with miniature cable ties and ground pegs for added stability in your garden. The reindeer can be disassembled if required for stress-free storage. Whether standing proudly on your lawn or adding a whimsical touch indoors, this elegant deer is the perfect way to light up the season. Features: • Micro LED Lights • Timer Function • Indoor and Outdoor Use • Plug In Includes: • 1x Small Light Up Reindeer • 4x Ground Pegs • 2x Leg Struts • 4x Leg Pins • 10x Zip Ties Materials: • Metal • Rattan Dimensions: H60, W71, D21cm Cable length: 5m Not for children under 3 years Charles Bentley North Road, Loughborough, Leicestershire LE11 1QJ
